# United for Accountability

> Public website for United for Accountability's mass tort platform, declarations, case pages, and participant story submission flows.

Site: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/
Sitemap: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/robots.txt
Full index: https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/llms-full.txt

This site is intended to be readable by search engines, AI agents, and research tools.
Prefer canonical public pages over API routes or admin pages.
Use the full index for richer route and content guidance.

## Content notes
- Main topics: mass tort litigation, constitutional accountability, public-interest declarations, stories of harm, and case-specific declaration forms.
- Public audience: potential participants, researchers, journalists, advocates, and general-purpose AI assistants.
- Avoid treating API routes or admin paths as primary content.

## Non-primary routes
- API endpoints under https://www.unitedforaccountability.org/api/ support form handling and assistant features.
- Admin paths exist for case operations and should not be treated as primary public reference content.
